## Phase: 67 - Long-Cadence Hook Firing Tests + Hook Firing-Coverage Gate

### Make the functional-smoke invariant machine-checkable (RED-first, un-gameable)
from: [[decision:hook-firing-coverage-gate]]
retrieved: 2026-05-29

- The functional-smoke invariant + [[HEU-012]] (verify firing, not presence) were enforced only by PROSE; this phase makes coverage a machine-checkable gate. Same unguarded-convention class eroded the session-start.sh line-cap (70→137 over 30+ phases) and caused 4 silent breakages (8–33 phases each). Fix the GENERATOR, not the 3 known holes.
- A self-authored coverage gate must be machine-bounded or it's worthless: a literal exemption allow-list asserted by membership+size + a denominator-sanity floor + a NEGATIVE CONTROL (a bogus uncovered hook must make it FAIL) — else "exempt everything" ships green. Build it RED-first so it reports the authoritative untested set, not a guessed list.

### Coverage denominator + signal — the two non-obvious gotchas
from: [[decision:hook-firing-coverage-gate]]
retrieved: 2026-05-29

- Denominator = UNION of `jq '.hooks[]|select((.type//"command")!="prompt")|.script'` + every `extra_dirs/*.sh`. Command hooks have NO `type` field (only py-review-stop-prompt.md is `type:"prompt"`); a literal `type=="command"` matches ZERO and falsely greens. The 3 session-start.d curators are registered via `extra_dirs`, NOT `.hooks[]`. Expected total ≈21 (17 command + 1 prompt + 3 curators).
- Bare-filename grep is an empirically useless coverage signal (3 probes): every hook name appears in test_registration.sh/test_settings_template.sh, and invocation uses `HOOK="…"; bash "$HOOK"` indirection. Coverage must be invocation-anchored/declared. Firing tests assert load-bearing SIDE-EFFECTS (a gutted no-op still exits 0), in mktemp-d + HOME-override isolation.
